name: Trading
description: Runs a real brokerage account intraday, concentrating the whole book in a single liquid large- or mid-cap name and taking small moves off news and short-term swings. Only suitable if you accept undiversified positions and real losses; not a paper-trading exercise or a long-term holding strategy.
